S074-01.notes: Two independent clauses joined by comma + and. A is a comma splice; B misplaces the comma; D has a stray comma after 'and'. Facts: ER resigned Feb 1939; concert Apr 9, 1939 (Easter Sunday), about 75,000. Accurate.

S074-02.notes: Plural subject 'recordings' with intervening appositive; B/C singular, D creates fragment. Ella's 200+ albums and 1956-64 songbooks are accurate.

S074-03.notes: Plural noun, no possession needed. Facts accurate.

S074-04.notes: Dangling modifier: 'Recovered and studied' must modify the bones. A, C, D attach it to researchers / relative / Homo naledi. Facts (Rising Star, 2013, narrow chute) accurate.

S074-05.notes: Colon introduces the noun phrase specifying the material. B leaves fragment after semicolon; C and D produce ungrammatical relative clauses ('that a frozen mixture...' lacks a verb). Pykrete (Project Habakkuk, ice + wood pulp/sawdust) accurate.

S074-06.notes: Compound subject 'rim and walls' takes plural 'prevent'. Present tense fits context. Accurate.

S074-07.notes: 'whose glow' possessive relative pronoun. C creates comma splice; A means 'who is'; B 'which glow' ungrammatical. Fungal luciferase accurate; 'foxfire' names both glow and glowing wood, so the 'which' after 'logs' is acceptable.

S074-08.notes: Dash introduces explanatory appositive. A and D leave fragments; C comma splice. Payne's 1984 discovery and multi-km range accurate.

S074-09.notes: Singular subject 'Evidence' despite intervening 'rocks' and 'levels'. A/B plural; D fragment. Chicxulub, iridium, 66 Ma accurate; 'most dinosaurs' acceptable (birds survived).

S074-10.notes: 'Teeming with' fits 3,000 galaxies in a seemingly blank region; B contradicts. HDF Dec 1995, ~10 days, ~3,000 galaxies accurate.

S074-11.notes: 'anxious buyers' of 'comet pills' signals alarm. Skepticism fails given the pills. 1910 cyanogen reports and comet pills accurate.

S074-12.notes: Gap in knowledge (the vanished city), then lidar filled it. Angkor Wat 12th century; 2012 lidar survey (published 2013) accurate.

S074-13.notes: 1856 is before 1859; Text 2 implies Foote preceded Tyndall. B unsupported (Text 2 does not mention water vapor, though Foote did historically test moist air). D misreads Henry's role. Facts accurate.

S074-14.notes: Chronological changes of use. Dates 537/1453/1934/2020 accurate (museum decree 1934, opened 1935).

S074-15.notes: Contrast of hundreds of signs/years of training with 22 letters that spread. A, B, C contradicted or overreach. 22-letter abjad by ~1050 BCE, Greek adaptation accurate.

S074-16.notes: Only B addresses both halves (dart 9.0 longest > glider 8.9 > stunt 5.2; glider avg 8.4 > dart 6.1). A compares to wrong design; C and D address only longest throw. Numbers check.

S074-17.notes: Removing surface particles restores color, implicating deposits rather than internal change. D is ambiguous between explanations. Consistent with Bergin et al. 2015 findings.

flags.note: Historical nuance: Langley had electronic computers (IBM 650/704) by the mid-1950s, and Vaughan's FORTRAN work largely came after the 1958 transition to NASA, after her segregated West Area unit was dissolved. Her teaching FORTRAN to her own staff is emphasized mainly in the Hidden Figures film; sources such as NASA's biography mainly say she taught herself FORTRAN and became an expert. Consider 'taught herself FORTRAN and encouraged her staff to learn it' or loosening the dates.

S074-18.notes: She saw the change coming and so prepared: 'Accordingly'. Nevertheless implies contrast; For example and Similarly do not fit.

flags.note: Minor anachronism: when Jackson petitioned (mid-1950s) the lab was NACA's Langley laboratory, not NASA's. NASA was formed in Oct 1958. 'NASA's first Black female engineer' is the standard phrasing and is fine.

S074-19.notes: The petition responds to the barrier. Other transitions do not fit.

S074-20.notes: Only B links West's model to daily GPS use. Dahlgren 1956, geodetic model, 2018 Hall of Fame accurate.

S074-21.notes: 'which' refers to the plural 'bacteria'. Treating 'light' as the antecedent gives nonsense, so 'lives' fails. D fragment. Present tense matches. Counterillumination by E. scolopes with V. fischeri is accurate.

S074-22.notes: Signed pieces drew higher prices, so signing others' pots suggests her signature added value (historically she did this to help other potters sell). B attributes an unsupported motive; C contradicts the price difference; D unsupported. Facts (around 1918, signing from the 1920s) accurate.
